answer: Here is one mechanism that works: score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because reef only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, anchor is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any haven approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
